name: B站搜索
description: 在B站搜索关键词，取回前10条视频结果（标题+链接+页面摘要）。

body.name: open_tab
body.note: 直接打开B站搜索结果页（比首页输入框更稳，不受首页改版影响）

body.name: waitForSelector
body.note: 等待结果卡片渲染完成

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const start=Date.now();let out=[];const isCover=(t)=>/^稍后再看/.test(t)||/\d{1,2}:\d{2}/.test(t);while(Date.now()-start<12000){out=[...document.querySelectorAll('.bili-video-card')].map(c=>{const links=[...c.querySelectorAll("a[href*='/video/BV']")];if(!links.length)return null;let href=links[0].getAttribute('href')||'';let url=href.startsWith('//')?('https:'+href):href;try{url=new URL(url,location.href).href;}catch{}const titEl=c.querySelector('.bili-video-card__info--tit');let title=titEl?(titEl.textContent||'').trim():'';if(!title){const t=links.map(x=>(x.textContent||'').trim()).find(x=>x.length>2&&!isCover(x));title=t||'';}if(!title||title.length<2)return null;const owner=c.querySelector('.bili-video-card__info--owner');const author=owner?(owner.textContent||'').split('·')[0].trim().slice(0,40):'';return {title:title.slice(0,150),url:url,author:author};}).filter(Boolean);const seen=new Set();out=out.filter(x=>!seen.has(x.url)&&seen.add(x.url));if(out.length>=3)break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));}return {count:out.length,links:out.slice(0,10),text:(document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,6000).trim()};})()

body.note: 卡片级抓取：标题优先 .bili-video-card__info--tit，兜底滤掉封面文本（稍后再看/播放量+弹幕+时长粘连）
